title: Release orchestration blueprint: API + Console + Runtime coordinated launch
creator: Leah Kim
description: Strategic coordination ticket to define milestone cadence, scope-lock cut criteria, release-notes ownership, and cross-team GTM tasks for the combined API / Console / Runtime release window. Goal: produce a single, deterministic flight plan that reduces ambiguity between engineering, docs, design, SRE, and sales. This ticket owns the orchestration blueprint (milestone dates, hard/soft cut criteria per area, signoff matrix, escalation paths) and the release-notes coordination plan (narrative owners, feature blurb templates, technical changelog entries, and final approval checklist). Workstreams include: 1) Finalize milestone calendar and dependency map; 2) Define scope lock and cut decision matrix per component (API, Console, Runtime); 3) Establish release-notes cadence and canonical source of truth; 4) GTM readiness tasks (customer comms, enablement, blog draft, release webinar); 5) Post-release rollback and incident communications playbook.
acceptance_criteria: Milestone calendar published and shared with all stakeholders and added to product calendar
Cut criteria document with explicit pass/fail signals for API, Console, Runtime (performance SLOs, blocker bug gating, security review) accepted by Eng, SRE, and Security
Release-notes owner roster defined with primary + backup for each section and a published changelog template
All required docs (PRD links, user-facing copy, admin notes) have owners and drafts in Google Drive by cutoff T-7 days
GTM playbook (emails, blog, webinar, sales one-pager) has draft signoff from Growth + Sales + Legal
Rollback and incident communications runbook created and validated in tabletop exercise with SRE and Support
deliverables: Release-notes master document (Drive) and changelog skeleton (markdown in repo)
Signoff matrix with stakeholder contacts (confluence page)
Post-release retrospective template and metrics dashboard link
stakeholders: PM leads: Leah Kim (owner), Priya Desai (Console PM)
Eng leads: Marco Alvarez (Runtime), Dana Cho (API)

risks: Design delay for Console access-control could push console GA and require staggered rollout
Performance regression in Runtime quantization path may fail cut criteria and force model rollback
Incomplete release notes from Eng could delay customer comms
Security review may surface mandatory changes that need re-architecture
mitigations: Adopt staggered rollout plan with feature-flag gating for Console UI changes
Prepare fallback model variant (non-quantized) and automated traffic-shift playbook
Enforce daily micro-deadlines for Eng blurbs and designate secondary author for each section
Escalation path to Architecture review panel with preallocated time during release week
